Node = service, edge = request rate + error rate + latency. Kubelet-probe pseudo-clients are filtered out so the force layout stays compact. Zoom & drag to explore.

((sum by (client, server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_failed_total{source="beyla", client=~"$svc", client!~"i-[0-9a-f]+", client_k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__range])) or sum by (client, server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_failed_total{source="beyla", server=~"$svc", client!~"i-[0-9a-f]+", server_k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__range]))) or ((sum by (client, server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{source="beyla", client=~"$svc", client!~"i-[0-9a-f]+", client_k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__range])) or sum by (client, server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{source="beyla", server=~"$svc", client!~"i-[0-9a-f]+", server_k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__range]))) * 0)) / (sum by (client, server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{source="beyla", client=~"$svc", client!~"i-[0-9a-f]+", client_k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__range])) or sum by (client, server, connection_type) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{source="beyla", server=~"$svc", client!~"i-[0-9a-f]+", server_k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[$__range])))

panels.title: LLM Call Stack — tokens, cost, models (Langfuse)

panels.description: Langfuse stores prompt/completion, token usage, cost, and evaluation scores in ClickHouse. Open the full LLM call stack for any request in Langfuse — traces share the same trace_id that Beyla propagates, so a slow span here maps 1:1 to a Langfuse trace.

options.content:
### 🔗 LLM details live in Langfuse

Beyla propagates the **W3C `traceparent`**, so each request carries **one `trace_id`** across the eBPF spans (Tempo, above) and the LLM observation (Langfuse).

**Drill-down flow:** slow **TTFT** panel → **Explore → Tempo** → open the trace → **Langfuse** link on the span (or use the header link) → prompt / completion / **tokens** / **cost** / eval score.

[Open Langfuse ↗](https://langfuse.${domain})
